name: Mercenary Remedy
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Remedy (players/priest/mercenary/remedy_merc.sval, 18 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 4 (in brackets): +100% (+200%). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Healing you receive is 100% more effective.
